plan: In a first-price sealed bid auction, my goal is to maximize expected profit. With a private value of $34, I want to bid strategically. I'll aim to bid lower than my full value to preserve profit margin. Since I don't know other bidders' values, I'll bid around 75% of my value to balance winning probability with potential profit. This means bidding around $25-$26 gives me a good chance of winning while keeping a reasonable profit if successful.
